name: Nanhua Futures Co., Ltd.
summary: Nanhua Futures Co., Ltd. provides future brokerage, wealth management, risk management, financial, and future investment consulting services in China and internationally. It offers future brokerage services, including commodity and financial future services; asset management business; and wealth management services, such as asset management, public fund, and securities investment fund agency services. The company also provides over-the-counter derivative, trading, market making, and other risk management-related services; and securities brokerage, foreign exchange trading, future investment consulting, financial training, securities investment consulting, and other services.
